pages.text: $(#7fe0ff)【Enlightenment】$()$(br2)Grants Enlightenment to monsters within 32 blocks: when they cannot reach their target, they dig through blocks, pillar up, bridge gaps or dig down. The Enlightened Stone they build with crumbles away after 30 seconds and drops nothing. Respects the mobGriefing rule.$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Circlet of Insight, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)A cluster of pale-gold crystals. Whoever touches it suddenly understands something.$()
